title: Trader Diary: 78K BTC Dip
content:
📉 78,020 and my brain: ‘Buy the dip!’
🧠 5 mins later: ‘Sell the dip, it’s a trap!’
🚀 1 hour later: ‘Why is my leverage screaming louder than my mom?’
lesson: Never let FOMO dictate position size—set your stop before the coffee gets cold.
question: Who else just rode the 0.6% rollercoaster and ended up buying at the bottom? Be honest 👇
